_comment: Task 1.7: systems of boneyard. Offsets in light-years from the region center (D12). Planets come in tasks 1.8 and 1.9.

systems.name: Ossuary (WIP)
systems.notes: Dim white dwarf; moon-sized Absent wrecks drift in loose orbits around it.
systems._comment: Star kind not given in the documents (R7, D16).

systems.name: Charnel (WIP)
systems.notes: Dim brown dwarf; Absent wrecks drift in loose orbits around it.
systems._comment: Star kind not given in the documents (R7, D16).

systems.name: Knell (WIP)
systems.notes: Dim red dwarf; Ferrous Consolidated's salvage concessions are concentrated here.
systems._comment: Star kind not given in the documents (R7, D16).

systems.name: The Spine (WIP)
systems.notes: An Absent wreck drifting between the Boneyard's stars, large enough to be charted as a system of its own.
systems._comment: PLAN.md: Boneyard systems may have a wreck at the center.

systems.notes: An Absent wreck drifting between the Boneyard's stars, large enough to be charted as a system of its own.

systems.notes: An Absent wreck drifting between the Boneyard's stars, large enough to be charted as a system of its own.

bodies.name: The Spine (WIP)
bodies.notes: A moon-sized Absent megastructure, broken open and drifting between the stars. It still shows heat on sensors.

bodies.name: The Keel (WIP)
bodies.notes: A long Absent hull, or something like one, drifting between the stars. Custodians have been seen on it.

bodies.name: The Bier (WIP)
bodies.notes: A flat, broad wreck like a platform, broken at one end. Custodians patrol its surface.

bodies.name: Sepulchre (WIP)
bodies.notes: A moon-sized Absent wreck, open along one side. Ferrous salvage crews work its outer decks.

bodies.name: Reliquary (WIP)
bodies.notes: A wreck that still has power: it shows on sensors as heat and, now and then, as light.

bodies.name: Catafalque (WIP)
bodies.notes: A long wreck tumbling slowly around the brown dwarf, matching nothing anyone can name.

bodies.name: Ribcage (WIP)
bodies.notes: A skeletal wreck of curving members, stripped of most of its alloys by salvagers.

bodies.name: The Lantern Hulk (WIP)
bodies.notes: A wreck that glows faintly from within. Salvage crews will not go aboard.

bodies.name: Concession station
bodies.notes: Ferrous Consolidated's base in the Boneyard, where about two thousand of its people work armed against custodians and the Unlit.

places.name: Spine salvage camp (WIP)
places.notes: Ferrous salvage crews stripping alloys nobody can manufacture.

places.name: Outer decks (WIP)
places.notes: The decks Ferrous crews have cleared of custodians, for now.

places.name: Custodian nest (WIP)
places.notes: Where custodians on the Keel are thickest. Independent salvagers mark it on their charts and stay away.

places.name: Independent camp (WIP)
places.notes: Independent salvagers working what Ferrous has not claimed.
